draft.title: AI Rivals Team Up at the UN
draft.script:
Why are fierce tech enemies suddenly joining forces?
OpenAI and Anthropic just urged the United Nations to cooperate on global artificial intelligence risks.
This means these major labs are finally admitting that unchecked computer intelligence could get completely out of hand.
For you, it means stronger safety guardrails and much more trustworthy technology coming your way.
Follow @gradientailabs for daily AI news.
draft.caption: OpenAI and Anthropic made a rare joint appearance at the United Nations to tackle the rising global risks of artificial intelligence. It is a massive shift to see competing tech giants working together on safety regulations. Do you think global watchdogs can successfully keep up with fast-moving AI technology?
